description.en: A glass status dot expands into three choices, with a springy tooltip that follows the active option.
description.zh: 玻璃状态圆点展开为三个选项，弹性提示气泡跟随当前选项移动。

keywords: 头像 状态 在线 专注 勿扰 玻璃 圆点 气泡 展开 选择器 弹簧 status picker avatar online focus do not disturb glass spring tooltip Nitish Khagwal

useCases: 切换头像在线、专注和勿扰状态
Choose a profile presence status from an expanding glass pill
discovery.caveat: 只切换本地展示状态，可用 onStatusChange 接入实际应用。原头像素材的再分发许可尚未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML, artwork and spring simulation adapted to a shared DOM lifecycle with six native framework entries.
source.license: No separate license was supplied or verified for the original HTML and embedded avatar. Preserve the source attribution and included font notices.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Click the status dot, then select Online, Focus or Do Not Disturb. Use the arrow keys to move between options and Escape to close.
instructions.zh: 点击状态圆点，可选择在线、专注或勿扰。方向键切换选项，Esc 收起。
